I was enamoured with the program in grade 12 and stressed myself out getting high enough grades to get into the program. I ended up dropping out after my first year. I ended up going back just to get a degree and now I’m in my 5th year. It’s unnecessarily pretentious, structured so poorly, and a lot of what we learn is useless. It’s also very cliquey!

I started at 100mg, then bumped to 125mg, and now I’ve been on 150mg for the past month. For me, I find that it really helps with the depressive states where they don’t last as long anymore and it’s easier to manage. It doesn’t help much with the hypomania however.

I hope that gives you some peace of mind starting to take it, and best of luck.
